games.name: [🐟] Fisch
games.desc:
🦈 Welcome to Fisch 🦈

Dive into Fisch, the ultimate fishing adventure where exploration and progression are yours to control. Cast your line to catch rare and unique fish, each with 400,000+ possible variations. Explore a growing world with your trusty rod, and maybe even reel in some new friends along the way!

[How To Fish]
• Hold down [LMB] to cast your bobber
• Await a bite. You can "shake" your rod to attract fish faster
• When you have a bite, hold down or click [LMB] to pull the bar white bar. Follow the blue line to the best of your ability; it's okay to mess up a few times!
• When the progress bar on the bottom is full, you'll reel in your catch!

Current Version • • 1.04.0

games.name: The Glass Bridge
games.desc:
ⓘ THIS GAME IS FINISHED AND WILL (most likely) NOT RECEIVE ANY MORE OFFICIAL UPDATES!

Step into a faithful recreation of the iconic Glass Bridge from Netflix's Squid Game. Test your luck and courage as you race to cross before the 5-minute timer runs out!

The bridge is made of randomized tempered and normal glass. Step on the wrong tile and it will shatter beneath you while tempered glass will hold your weight. Earn 10 points for discovering a safe tile first and 1000 points for reaching the other side. Spend points on abilities like Push or Glass Checker, and climb onto global leaderboards!

Recent Updates:
• push & kick countering
• revives

Upcoming Updates:
• CLIENT LAG FIX

Exploiters are banned permanently.
